notes.title: Patch 1.1.5 Released: Bug Fixes & Enhanced Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.notes:
Arderico's Journey has just been updated to its latest version, 1.1.5. Alongside a few bug fixes we are glad to announce that this update brings improved support for playing on Steam Deck!

Patchnotes for version 1.1.5:


 Fixed rare error where the UI would crash when text size was not set correctly
 Improved text readability on Steam Deck
 Fixed minor UI issue (misplaced button on the options screen) on Steam Deck
 Achievements gained while offline will now unlock when starting a new game or loading a saved game
 Further refined UI/UX and handling
 Fixed a minor UI glitch when restarting the game
 Fixed a glitch where the game would sometimes not pause correctly between text blocks


Known issue: There's a possible timing glitch when using the space bar to progress immediately after loading a save from the in-game menu - currently there's no fix, you can still use the left mouse button to progress correctly though.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Dear Fans,

After having to postpone Arderico’s Journey by a month, we are thrilled to announce the final release date. Your adventure begins on August 14, 2024!

We are using the additional time to make further optimizations, ensuring you have a polished experience on release day.

Thank you for your understanding and support. We can't wait for you to finally dive into the world of our first adventure, Arderico’s Journey.

Steve & Marc | Digital Masquerade
